description:
Get everything needed to decide on one application: the person, their answers and the bounty's terms.
Use for: deciding whether to accept or reject one applicant.
Not for: reading every applicant of a bounty (list_applications); reading a hire after the accept (get_hire).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: get_application({"applicationId":"a3Vn8cQe1RuY6wHs"})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.
name: get_application

actions.description: Tools you may call on this application now. Each tool still checks.

answer.description: Text, a yes or no, or the options chosen. Left out when no answer is stored; a file question carries files instead. false is a no, and [] means no option was chosen.

url.description: Download link. Send your credential to read it.

completedJobs.description: Hires this person finished and was paid for.

earned.description: What this person was paid on the platform so far.

profile.description: Left out when the person has no profile record.

hireCount.description: Jobs completed and paid out on RentAHuman, verified from payment records (same as verifiedTrackRecord.paidJobs).

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

isPaidWork.description: The job this review is about was paid out to the worker.

job.description: The bounty it is about, whether the worker was paid or the client refunded, and any dispute outcome.

source.description: Who wrote it: buyer (the client), or RentAHuman (withdrawal, managed, qa_engine, ai_backfill). Read the label before the stars.

rating.description: Average rating of work. Left out before the first rating ("new"), never 0. Withdrawal notes are not counted.

paidJobs.description: Jobs completed and paid out on RentAHuman, from payment records.

repeatClients.description: Clients who paid this person for two or more jobs.

summary.description: One line to read first, e.g. "3 jobs completed and paid out (verified from payment records)". "New" means no paid job yet, not a bad record.

withdrawalCount.description: Automatic notes for spots this person withdrew from after starting (refunded, not paid). Not ratings and not in rating.

appliedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

bonuses.description: For an accepted application still on its spot, the bonuses its funded spot was hired with. An application stored as expired or completed shows as accepted and carries the listing's current bonuses, as today's context does. Every other application carries the listing's current bonuses.

amount.description: Pay per spot in whole US cents: total for fixed pay, or rate per hour for hourly pay.

open.description: Spots today's rules let you hire into right now. 0 on a paused or ended bounty and on a draft you still have to fund with fund_bounty; a draft that is paid for another way shows its open count.

payLater.description: How many of total are not paid for up front. You pay a worker in one when the work is done. Only the platform adds these.

total.description: Every spot you can hire into: paid up front plus pay-later.

hireId.description: Set once accepted. Use it with the hire tools.

reply.description: The message sent with the accept or reject.

title: Get an application
